title: Fix the type error
prompt: The starter tries to join a number to text and fails. Fix it with a conversion so level_label(3) returns "Level 3".
hints: Run it and read the error: it says the types do not go together.

docs.name: str(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as text (a String).

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings. Joining text to a number is an error; convert first.
